facts.claim: Transforms CSV and JSON datasets into 4 synchronized accessibility layers: spatial Web Audio sonification, tactile geometric SVG patterns, Machado 2009 color-blind safe palettes, and W3C contextual screen-reader widgets

Resolves Highcharts Sonification Studio Issue #28 (Point k of N contextual readout), Chart2Music Issue #689 (NVDA arrow navigation), and MAIDR Issue #361 (single-key C High-Contrast mode with pattern preservation)
Passed 14 of 14 Playwright headless Firefox end-to-end scenarios across Desktop 1440x900 and Mobile 390x844 on both deployed GitHub Pages and local builds
Achieved 100% pass rate across the 12-case Real-World Validation Suite and 5-case Untouched Vega Hold-Out Suite with 4.6ms average parse latency, outperforming Chart2Music baseline (41.7% pass rate)
Uses cloud LLM neural voice cloning or supports 50 simultaneous series
